summary.headline: Seoul Electronics & Telecom amends rights offering: 2,025,137 new shares at KRW 1,432, KRW 2.2bn debt repayment
summary.what_happened: On Nov 27, 2026, Seoul Electronics & Telecom filed a corrected major-matters report for a third-party allotment rights offering first disclosed on Aug 7, 2026. The amended filing raises the new share count to 2,025,137 common shares (from 1,950,584), sets the issue price at KRW 1,432 (from KRW 1,538), and moves the payment date to Dec 14, 2026 with listing expected on Jan 22, 2027.
summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, a third-party allotment rights offering issues new shares to selected investors rather than existing shareholders pro rata, which can increase the total share count and dilute existing holders' ownership. Corrected filings typically reflect changes in allotment, pricing, or use of proceeds and are worth reviewing alongside the original disclosure.
